classification: Prerequisite base-specialist training. NOT latent-strategy work, NOT DEFEND_ATTACK_SPLIT_POLICY work, NOT DEFEND_TEACHER work -- this record only trains an entity-repair 6v6 pi_A/pi_B pair to replace the two existing pre-entity-repair 6v6 specialists as the base the 4v4-derived DEFEND-teacher/split-policy architecture would eventually build on. No CLOSEST_DEFENDS, no role-conditioning, no DEFEND-teacher, no split-attack-defend flag is enabled anywhere in this record.
authorized_by: PI, 2026-09-22: 'Move to 6v6... The larger 4v4 evaluation is validation, not another prerequisite to progress. Best workflow: freeze 4v4 exactly as-is, then start 6v6, and if you have spare GPUs, let the n=128 4v4 confirmation run in parallel without blocking 6v6.' This record is the first concrete step of that instruction.
SCIENTIFIC_DELTA_plain_english: The two existing 6v6 pole checkpoints (pi_A_specialist_6v6, pi_B_specialist_6v6, both from experiments/run_r1_repertoire_training.py::build_r1_config, trained 2026-09-08/09, seed 7610001/7620001, BEFORE entity-repair existed in this codebase -- entity-repair landed 2026-09-13 in commit bd7e9fcb) already show essentially no learned specialization crossover: the sealed SHARE0_6V6_TEACHER diagnostic (n=128, SHARE0_6V6_TEACHER_SPECIALIST_CROSSOVER_EVAL_RESULT.json) measured delta_A=+0.0078 [lcb95 -0.0703] FAIL and delta_B=+0.0078 [lcb95 -0.0234] FAIL under the canonical crossover convention. This is the same near-zero-specialization signature entity-repair was built to fix at 4v4 (see docs 4v4 scaffold-to-native representability audit: NOT_REPRESENTABLE_VOCABULARY via DIRECTION only, fixed by observation-side entity repair). This record applies the SAME, already-validated fix to the 6v6 pair, warm-started from the existing checkpoints (not from scratch), mirroring exactly how the 4v4 entity-repair pair (pi_A_specialist_4v4_b3_entity_repair, pi_B_specialist_4v4_b3_entity_repair_corrected) was itself warm-started from the plain pre-entity-repair pi_A/B_specialist_4v4_b3 checkpoints of the same lineage (run_r1_repertoire_training.py::build_r1_config).

claim_boundary: This record establishes only whether the entity-repair fix, applied to the existing 6v6 R1-repertoire pair via warm start, changes the near-zero specialization signature the pair showed in the pre-existing SHARE0 diagnostic. It does not itself constitute a 6v6 split-policy port, and does not authorize any DEFEND-teacher or split-attack-defend training at 6v6 without a separate PI-reviewed spec, mirroring the exact staged sequence already used at 4v4 (entity-repair pair first, crossover checked, THEN DEFEND-teacher/split-policy layered on top).
